title: In silico simulations reveal molecular mechanism of uranyl ion toxicity towards DNA-binding domain of PARP-1 protein
authors: Egor S. Bulavko; Dmitry N. Ivankov
one_liner_zh: 该文通过QM/MM模拟研究铀酰离子破坏PARP-1锌指DNA结合域的结构机制，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但对象非典型TF-DNA，且方法侧重毒性机理而非结合预测或建模，故为中档。
abstract: The molecular toxicity of uranyl ion (UO 2 2+ ) in living cells is mainly conditioned by its high affinity to both native and potential metal-binding sites frequently occurring in biomolecules structure. Recent advances in computational and experimental research shed light on the structural properties and functional impacts of uranyl binding to proteins, organic ligands, nucleic acids and their complexes. In the present work, we report the results of the theoretical investigation of the uranyl-mediated loss of DNA-binding activity of PARP-1, eukaryotic enzyme that participates in DNA reparation, cell differentiation, induction of inflammation, etc. Latest experimental studies showed that uranyl ion directly interacts with its DNA-binding subdomains – zinc fingers Zn1 and Zn2, – and changes their tertiary structure. Here, we propose an atomistic mechanism underlying this process and compute the free energy change along the suggested pathway to prove its relevance. According to the results of our QM/MM simulations of Zn2-UO 2 2+ complex, uranyl ion replaces zinc in its native binding site, but the corresponding state is destroyed because of the following spontaneous internal hydrolysis of the U–Cys162 coordination bond. Although the enthalpy of hydrolysis is +2.8 kcal/mol, the final value of the free energy of the reaction constitutes -0.6 kcal/mol, due to structure loosening evidenced by solvation and configuration thermodynamic properties calculated using GIST- and MIST-based trajectory processing techniques. The subsequent reorganization of the binding site includes association of uranyl ion with the Glu190/Asp191 acidic cluster and significant perturbations in the domain’s tertiary structure, which further decreases the free energy of the non-functional state by 6.8 kcal/mol. The disruption of the DNA-binding interface revealed in our computational simulations is consistent with previous experimental findings and appears to be associated with the loss of the Zn2 affinity for nucleic acids.
abstract_zh: 铀酰离子（UO₂²⁺）在活细胞中的分子毒性主要取决于其对生物分子结构中常见天然及潜在金属结合位点的高亲和力。计算与实验研究的最新进展揭示了铀酰与蛋白质、有机配体、核酸及其复合物结合的结构特性和功能影响。在本工作中，我们报告了铀酰介导的PARP-1（一种参与DNA修复、细胞分化、炎症诱导等过程的真核酶）DNA结合活性丧失的理论研究结果。最新实验研究表明，铀酰离子直接与其DNA结合亚结构域——锌指Zn1和Zn2——相互作用，并改变其三级结构。在此，我们提出该过程背后的原子机制，并计算沿建议路径的自由能变化以证明其相关性。根据我们对Zn2-UO₂²⁺复合物的QM/MM模拟结果，铀酰离子取代了其天然结合位点中的锌，但相应状态因随后U–Cys162配位键的自发内部水解而被破坏。尽管水解焓为+2.8 kcal/mol，但反应的最终自由能值为-0.6 kcal/mol，这是由于使用基于GIST和MIST的轨迹处理技术计算得到的溶剂化和构象热力学性质所证实的结构松散化。结合位点的后续重组包括铀酰离子与Glu190/Asp191酸性簇的缔合，以及结构域三级结构的显著扰动，这进一步将非功能态的自由能降低6.8 kcal/mol。我们计算模拟中揭示的DNA结合界面破坏与先前实验发现一致，并似乎与Zn2对核酸亲和力的丧失相关。
